key_insight: Func-R1 tackles a key failure mode in multimodal math reasoning: models can solve text-based function problems yet still ignore important visual cues.
engineering_relevance: The paper is relevant for building MLLMs that must reliably combine perception and symbolic reasoning in chart, graph, and geometry-style function tasks.
method: Decoupled architecture separates visual perception from theoretical reasoning.
Hierarchical post-training progressively identifies critical visual evidence before deeper reasoning.
Perception-Aligned Theoretic Optimization (PATO) updates policy to preserve theory while correcting visual inputs during reasoning.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive benchmark gains, including an 8.4% improvement over GPT-5 on MathVerse function-oriented tasks.
watch_item: Performance claims are benchmark-specific, so deployment may still depend on how well the model generalizes to new visual function formats and noisy images.
paper_title: Func-R1: Incentivizing Mathematical Function Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
